name: preview_app
description: Publish a workspace web app as a live Matrix preview. Pass only the app directory. The system detects the runtime and framework, uploads the project, installs dependencies, starts the server, verifies the public custom URL, and returns either an explicit success with preview_url or an exact stage-specific error. args: app_directory

app_directory.description: Absolute path inside /workspace, or a path relative to /workspace, containing the web app.
